strings.name: Nikola Jokić
strings.summary: Jokić developed in Serbian professional basketball before Denver selected him in the second round of the 2014 NBA draft. A center who directs passing and offense, he won three regular-season MVP awards and helped the Nuggets win their first NBA title in 2023, earning Finals MVP. His Olympic silver and bronze with Serbia also mark the growing influence of European players.
